title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to Federal Register notice 2025-22754 (originally beginning on page 57963, December 15, 2025): removal of Arms Sales Notifications dated August 25, 2022 from pages 57964 and 57965.
summary: This Federal Register document is a correction to an earlier DSCA arms sales notice (document 2025-22754, published December 15, 2025). It instructs that the Arms Sales Notifications dated August 25, 2022, printed on pages 57964 and 57965, should be removed. No sale country, dollar value, or equipment is stated in this correction.
